name: Supabase (Express on Supabase Postgres)
opening: This is an Express shop whose products, users and orders are in a Supabase project. Its server connects through Supabase's transaction pooler: the host sets DATABASE_URL and SUPABASE_CA_CERT in the server's environment, not in a file. Enable Bitcoin and stablecoin payments with OpenReceive. Follow these directions: {{directions_url}}
